versions.changelog: Display name: the card showed the bare slug; the artifact now declares x402 Market Recon in agents/openai.yaml, matching the name on xhagents.xyz. No code change.

Card metadata fix: display name set, and category plus topics declared (the card used to show the bare slug and 'Other'). Wording: the trigger section is rewritten for discovery, and the --allow-any-host help text now says it is an opt-in that prints every host before reading it. Read-only artifact unchanged otherwise.

Security review fixes: optional paid path removed entirely (no key handling, no signing, no spending in this artifact); enforced destination policy (https only, host allowlist via --allow-any-host, refusal of loopback/private/link-local/metadata addresses on DNS and on every redirect hop, response size caps, request budget); declared allowed-tools plus a permissions block; illustrative example URLs replaced.
first release: registry demand census, live 402 delivery probe, manifest-vs-live comparison, optional paid call under a hard ceiling
